featuredContent.title: Startale Group and SBI Holdings Introduce JPYSC, the First Trust Bank-Backed JPY Stablecoin
featuredContent.description: JPYSC is a Type III electronic payment instrument issued by Shinsei Trust & Banking, jointly developed with SBI Holdings, distributed via SBI VC Trade, and built for institutional cross-border and treasury payments.

featuredContent.title: SBI Holdings unveils trust bank-backed JPY stablecoin with Q2 launch target
featuredContent.description: JPYSC will be Japan's first trust bank-issued yen stablecoin, distinguishing it from JPYC's prepaid payment instrument classification. Trust-based issuers may allocate up to 50% of reserves to government bonds.

milestones.title: Startale and SBI unveil Strium L1 for tokenized securities and RWA trading
milestones.description: Strium described as destination for a 'complementary currency stack' of JPYSC and USDSC; likely deployment target for JPYSC.

milestones.title: Startale Group and SBI Holdings unveil JPYSC, first trust bank-backed JPY stablecoin
milestones.description: Brand and logo announced; issuer Shinsei Trust & Banking, distributor SBI VC Trade, technical lead Startale Group; Q2 2026 launch target under Japan's Type III electronic payment instrument framework.

milestones.title: Startale closes $63M Series A (SBI $50M + Sony $13M) earmarked for JPYSC expansion
milestones.description: Funds target Strium scaling, stablecoin expansion (JPYSC + USDSC), and Startale App enhancement; confirms JPYSC remains a 2026 priority.

milestones.title: SBI VC Trade begins RLUSD distribution in Japan — JPYSC distributor infrastructure now live
milestones.description: SBI VC Trade, JPYSC's designated distributor, operationally distributing Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, de-risking the JPYSC distribution pathway.
